programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Nadie le cree al Abuelo Pitufo cuando habla de junglas y sabanas lejanas, repletas de gatos salvajes gigantes, caballos a rayas, comedores de hojas de cuello largo y extrañas tribus… Tan solo algunos Pitufitos dan cierto crédito a sus historias. Pero, cuando Abuelo Pitufo escucha en el bosque el sonido del tambor real mágico, un instrumento capaz de domar bestias salvajes, se lanza a la aventura para demostrar que no es un contador de historias al que el cerebro le juega malas pasadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina guía a los Pitufos de caminata por la naturaleza, pero Puppy se adelantó demasiado y tras perseguirlo acaban en el territorio de los Wartmongers. El Rey de los Wartmongers acaba haciéndoles prisioneros en burbujas, pero un grupo de rebeldes les rescata y consiguen huir a lomos de Puppy.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué, o quién, es ese extraño ser que hay en el bosque? Se asemeja vagamente a un Pitufo, pero castañetea los dientes como la ardilla que parece acompañarle… ¿y por qué habla Papá Pitufo acerca del Pitufito Perdido?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo y diabólico plan para librarse de los Pitufos: un polvo brillante que hará que no puedan dejar de reírse…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero es el encargado de arreglar todos los desperfectos en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero ¿valoran de verdad los demás Pitufos sus esfuerzos? De ningún modo. Al menos eso es lo que siente Pitufo Carpintero, quien decide abandonar la Aldea Pitufa para siempre e irse a vivir al mar con Marina, la sirena…

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Ninguno de los Pitufos parece tener tiempo para jugar con los Pitufitos. Deciden visitar a Padre Tiempo y llegan al Río del Tiempo, la inmensa corriente que fluye majestuosamente, transportando todo el tiempo del mundo. Entonces, se produce un accidente que tendrá inoportunas consecuencias…

programme.title: La Aguja Mágica De Pitufo Sastre
programme.desc: Pitufo Sastre tiene que crear un conjunto para cada Pitufo antes del desfile de moda de otoño. Pitufo Filósofo quiere ayudarle y, usando el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo, conjura una aguja mágica que cose diez veces más rápido que un sastre… ¿Pero es eso algo realmente bueno?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Selwyn y Tallulah son un matrimonio de poderosos hechiceros. El problema es que están todo el rato peleándose. La energía de sus discusiones está formando una temible tormenta, y Papá Pitufo debe conseguir que hagan las paces antes de que la tormenta arrecie.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Baltasar lleva a Denisa con Gargamel para que este haga de canguro. Sin embargo, Gargamel pierde a Denisa en el bosque y esta se encuentra con Sasita y se hace amiga de ella. Sasita y Denisa colaboran para sacar a los Pitufos del caldero de Gargamel y demostrar que la valentía no es cuestión de tamaño.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Guillermo, el bufón de la corte, es el amigo humano de los Pitufos. Va a haber un festejo en el castillo del rey y Guillermo invita amablemente a sus pequeños amigos azules al banquete. Sin embargo, descubren que el malévolo chambelán está afanando las posesiones del rey.

programme.title: El Amigo Más Pitufo
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo tenía un amigo: Pitufo Torpe. Pero el pobre Pitufo Torpe es tan… bueno, torpe, que Pitufo Filósofo no quiere volverle a ver. Así que ahora no queda nadie dispuesto a escucharle. Quizá Buddy, el apuesto diablillo que ha conocido por casualidad cerca del gran roble, pueda convertirse en amigo de Pitufo Filósofo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una de las cosas con las que más disfruta Abuelo Pitufo es contar una buena historia de miedo, y a la mayoría de los Pitufos les encantan. Sin embargo, las cosas se complican para Pitufo Filósofo cuando Abuelo Pitufo habla de las pitufiánimas y estas comienzan a acecharle…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para demostrar lo válido que es su «Gran libro de supervivencia en la naturaleza», Pitufo Filósofo se lleva a los Pitufitos al pantano. Allí, gracias a su experto consejo, el pequeño grupo se extravía, queda atrapado en arenas movedizas y es capturado por el Rey Verrugoso. Afortunadamente, el Rey Verrugoso está con ganas de jugar y decide hacer una caza del Pitufo. Desafortunadamente, Pitufo Filósofo cree que es un líder por naturaleza…

programme.title: La Carrera De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un nuevo invento: el pitufimóvil. Todos los Pitufos tienen su propio vehículo personalizado y todos (o casi todos) disfrutan dando una vuelta en ellos. Sin embargo, el malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la idea y empieza a causar problemas a los Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En la antigua India, el pérfido faquir Gargapuri vende a los Pitufos al rajá para su zoo privado. Únicamente Abuelo Pitufo, Pitufo Salvaje y Pitufo Bromista quedan libres, así que tendrán que entrar a hurtadillas en el palacio para rescatar a sus amigos. Por el camino, liberan a todos los animales enjaulados de la colección del rajá.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel inventa la leyenda del Pitufo Hechicero para engañar a Papá Pitufo y sus amigos Pitufos y conducirlos hacia una trampa en lo alto de la montaña. Papá Pitufo, con su ingenio, engaña al mago con algo de sus propia magia y Gargamel es perseguido montaña abajo y devuelto de nuevo a su castillo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Belleza Es Superficial
programme.desc: Periwinkle, un hada vanidosa, se molesta cuando su espejo mágico le dice que el ser más hermoso es Pitufo Vanidoso, y no ella. Periwinkle secuestra a Pitufo Vanidoso, pero los demás Pitufos acuden al rescate. Periwinkle se da cuenta de que ha obrado mal y se convierten en amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufina se encuentra con una amable y anciana gitana en el bosque y esta le regala un vestido multicolor con vuelo, se muestra encantada. ¿Quién hubiera imaginado que, en realidad, esa mujer era el malvado mago Gargamel disfrazado y que el hermoso vestido oculta un terrible hechizo?

programme.title: La Carrera De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un nuevo invento: el pitufimóvil. Todos los Pitufos tienen su propio vehículo personalizado y todos (o casi todos) disfrutan dando una vuelta en ellos. Sin embargo, el malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la idea y empieza a causar problemas a los Pitufos…

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La jungla de Sudamérica no es precisamente el lugar en el que Pitufo Vanidoso querría pasar el resto de sus días. Además, empieza a bailar como un poseso cuando contrae la fiebre tropical. Su danza tendrá extrañas consecuencias.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se encuentran en una paradisíaca isla del Pacífico. Bueno, no exactamente paradisíaca, ya que hay un volcán muy activo en el que Pitufo Fortachón, también muy activo, arriesga tanto su vida como la de Pitufina.

programme.title: El Color Mas Pitufoso
programme.desc: Spectra es el hada de los colores, y con su rueda de los colores crea todos los azules, rojos, amarillos y verdes del mundo. Es amiga de Pitufo Pintor, pero, cuando este lleva a los Pitufitos a su morada en su ausencia, los Pitufitos se ponen a jugar con la rueda de los colores… y provocan que todos los colores desaparezcan de la Tierra. Y, lo que es aún peor: sin colores, el hada de los colores no puede vivir…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un duende maligno le pone unos zapatos mágicos a Pitufina, que no puede dejar de bailar, con la intención de que le prometa que se casará con él. Todos sus pequeños amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papá Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos mágicos al duende, obligándole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: El Pitufo Galante
programme.desc: La reina Agripina no dejará que su hijo, el príncipe Godofredo, se case con la dulce Priscila. Ella quiere como nuera a una chica que sea capaz de mostrarle algo que nunca antes haya visto. Cuando Hogata se entera y descubre la existencia de Abuelo Pitufo, está segura de que logrará sorprender a la reina con su captura. Por supuesto, Hogata debe atrapar primero a Abuelo Pitufo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. Desafortunadamente, su treta se vuelve en su contra y, en lugar de amorosos cuidados, todo lo que recibe es un proverbial merecido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada vez que Pitufo Perezoso se queda dormido, tiene la misma pesadilla una y otra vez: se encuentra en poder de Morfeo, un malvado hechicero que quiere capturar a tantas almas dormidas como sea posible. Uno tras otro, todos los Pitufos van cayendo en las garras de Morfeo. ¿Todos? Quizá no, si Papá Pitufo puede evitarlo. Para ello, Papá Pitufo acude al Arenero en busca de ayuda…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La primavera provoca que todos los Pitufos estén compitiendo por el amor de Pitufina y Gargamel decide hechizarla para que le ayuda a capturarlos. Papá Pitufo toma cartas en el asunto y con la ayuda del despistado gato Azrael consigue darle la vuelta al plan.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En la Aldea Pitufo hay un ataque de Mala Suerte y cien Pitufos deben bailar una danza mágica para recuperar la buena fortuna, ¡pero sólo hay 99 en la aldea! ¿Quién será el centésimo Pitufo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos intentan evitar el contacto con los humanos. Esta vez, sin embargo, Sasita se ha hecho amiga de una pequeña bruja llamada Melina, cuyos hechizos suelen acabar en desastre. De todas formas, ¿son las brujas realmente humanas? En cualquier caso, los brujos como Gargamel sí que lo son.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos serían un delicioso manjar para el malvado mago Gargamel si no fuera por dos cosas: son difíciles de atrapar y también muy pequeños. Ahora bien, si hubiera una fórmula que permitiera transformar a esos pequeños aperitivos de bocado en grandes y jugosas raciones azules… Gargamel ha tenido una idea…

programme.title: Pituplicación
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel crea una fórmula mágica que duplica todo aquello que toca. Y…¡sorpresa! ¡Ahora hay seis Pitufos Filósofos! Esto provoca algunas situaciones interesantes en la aldea… ¡Y también en casa de Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En la antigua India, el pérfido faquir Gargapuri vende a los Pitufos al rajá para su zoo privado. Únicamente Abuelo Pitufo, Pitufo Salvaje y Pitufo Bromista quedan libres, así que tendrán que entrar a hurtadillas en el palacio para rescatar a sus amigos. Por el camino, liberan a todos los animales enjaulados de la colección del rajá.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador verá cumplido su deseo de ser un Astropitufo cuando Papá Pitufo le hechiza para quedarse dormido, transformando el paisaje y a los Pitufos en una fantasía galáctica. Gargamel vigila de cerca las travesuras de los Pitufos desde su bola de cristal, pero el hechizo de Papá Pitufo también tiene efecto en él y le transporta hasta el centro de una tormenta.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es la primera Navidad de Pitufo Salvaje y está impresionado por la decoración de la Aldea Pitufa. Pero Abuelo Pitufo y Sasita van a enseñarle el auténtico significado de la Navidad cuando ayudan a una pareja de ancianos a disfrutar de la Navidad más hermosa que jamás hayan vivido…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La vida en la Aldea Pitufa podría ser más tranquila si Puppy se comportara un poco mejor. Sin embargo, el pequeño perro de los Pitufos se dedica a escarbar entre las flores de Pitufina, ensuciar el nuevo papel pintado de Pitufo Vanidoso y arruinar los experimentos de Papá Pitufo. Aun así, Puppy va a ayudar a los Pitufos a escapar de una trampa que les ha tendido Gargamel. O quizá no tenga la disciplina necesaria para ello…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿A dónde se han ido todas las ardillas? Pitufo Salvaje está algo preocupado. Y estaría aún más preocupado si supiera el malvado plan que ha tramado la horrible bruja Hogata para preparar un tónico capilar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata…

programme.title: La Pitufo Sinfonía
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía tiene prohibido tocar en la Aldea Pitufo y Gargamel aprovecha para engañarlo e intentar capturar Pitufos con un hechizo musical.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos liberan a los Pitufos de las garras de Gargamel justo a tiempo para llevar a Bebé Pitufo a la ceremonia de su primera palabra. Bebé Pitufo pronuncia la palabra «Gargamel». Papá Pitufo afirma que esa palabra indica que Bebé Pitufo se convertirá un día en un gran líder, ya que significa que es consciente de los peligros de la vida.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a la nueva cama de Papá Pitufo para que cualquiera que duerma en ella sea transportado al lugar con el que esté soñando. Los ensueños de los Pitufos les llevan a un barco, un castillo y, por último, hasta Gargamel. Consiguen escapar cuando Pitufo Torpe se queda dormido y sueña con su hogar.

programme.title: Pitufo En Rascacielos
programme.desc: Está claro que una aldea de casas con forma de seta es bonita y alegre… Sin embargo, no resulta muy moderna a los ojos de Pitufo Arquitecto. Lo que los Pitufos necesitan es un rascacielos, un nuevo y atrevido concepto que cambiará su forma de vivir para siempre…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Llamen Al Doctor Pitufo
programme.desc: Tal como su propio nombre indica, Pitufo Aficionado es incapaz de concentrarse en una actividad concreta. Pasa de una cosa a otra con tremenda facilidad y nunca termina lo que empieza. Pero, de repente, descubre que le apasiona la profesión médica. Pitufo Aficionado quiere convertirse en doctor y todos los Pitufos, con Papá Pitufo a la cabeza, van a ayudarle a cumplir su deseo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel vuelve a estar en problemas. Si no puede reunir una enorme cantidad de oro para el atardecer, le arrebatarán todas sus posesiones. Sin embargo, los Pitufos van a ayudar a su archienemigo… hasta cierto punto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Si hay algo que la malvada hechicera Clorhidris no puede soportar es la felicidad de las demás personas. Contemplar la vida de los Pitufos, llena de amabilidad y canciones, pone furiosa a Clorhidris. Debe destruir esas risas y ahogar esas felices conversaciones… Entonces, planta la raíz del mal en el bosque y, poco después, todos los Pitufos dejan de hablarse. El único que no se ha visto afectado es Bebé Pitufo…

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Genio inventa una máquina que hará todo el trabajo de cosechar y preparar la comido de los Pitufos. Pero esta milagrosa invención tiene sus bemoles.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Robotín se siente tan solo que, compadeciéndose de él, Pitufo Carpintero le construye una compañera. El problema es que PituforRobotínina no sabe que únicamente debe fijarse en su compañero mecánico, o que debe evitar a Gargamel…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando Escrupuloso, el ayudante del malvado Gargamel, encuentra el Gran libro de hechizos en el sótano de su maestro, le pide poder para convertirse en el mago más poderoso del mundo. Y esto supondrá problemas para los pobres Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo le da a Pitufo Debilucho una crema especial para que la utilice y recupere su fuerza. Poco después, recibe una condecoración por sus heroicos actos de fortaleza, y su autoestima se dispara cuando se da cuenta de que la crema es simplemente mermelada de pitufrutas.

programme.title: El Capricho De Travieso
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que, si atrapas un trol, este puede concederte un deseo? Resulta que Aloysius el trol ha quedado atrapado en una de las pitufitrampas de Gargamel. Pitufo Colérico le libera y, como recompensa, consigue que los demás Pitufos satisfagan todos sus caprichos. Esto acarrea un montón de problemas para los Pitufos, ya que los Pitufitos, en ocasiones, piden cosas que no son buenas para ellos… ni tampoco para los demás.

programme.title: Don Pituzorro
programme.desc: Todo el mundo tiene sus propios sueños. El de Pitufina es conocer al legendario Don Pituzorro, el gallardo, ingenioso e intrépido héroe de numerosas y cautivadoras aventuras. Los Pitufos no toman en serio ese encaprichamiento. Sin embargo, cuando un Don Pituzorro real aparece en la aldea y Pitufina les ignora en favor del jactancioso extraño, se toman el asunto algo más en serio.

programme.title: Sorpresa Para Sassette
programme.desc: A veces, los pequeños actos pueden tener grandes consecuencias. Mientras intentaba atrapar a Sasita, Gargamel altera la Balanza de la Verdad y, desde ese momento, todos los habitantes del mundo comienzan a mentir. Incluso Papá Pitufo se ha convertido en un mentiroso compulsivo. Y, por si eso fuera poco, el espíritu de la balanza ha encadenado juntos a Gargamel y Sasita, que deberán volver a colocar en su sitio el Topacio de la Verdad…

programme.title: Pitufos Helados
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos están a punto de sucumbir al intenso frío. ¿Podrá Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuidar de los animales produce consecuencias inesperadas cuando los Pitufos deciden llevar a un bebé dinosaurio de vuelta a casa… ¡a su propia era! Este es el inicio de una serie de aventuras en las que recorrerán el espacio y el tiempo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras intenta escabullirse de sus tareas, Pitufo Perezoso encuentra un antiguo pozo abandonado con una interesante peculiaridad: cualquier objeto que uno baje en el cubo regresa como nuevo. Pero ¿es eso bueno?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mítico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotará al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podrán los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: Pitufos Y Solo Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido capturar a Pitufina. Ahora, se dispone a administrarle un suero de la verdad para descubrir todos los secretos de Papá Pitufo… pero Gargamel comete un gran error y le da a Pitufina una fórmula de las mentiras.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Abuelo Pitufo llevaba algunos cientos de años sin ver su antiguo juguete. Se lo entregaron a Papá Pitufo hace mucho tiempo y no recuerda exactamente cómo funciona. ¡Pero Bebé Pitufo sabe que tiene sorpresas para todos!

programme.title: Aquel Que Pitufa El Último…
programme.desc: Pitufo Bromista se pasa de la raya con sus bromas cuando Clorhidris cae víctima de una de ellas. Para vengarse de los Pitufos, crea un hechizo para robar su sentido del humor. Pitufo Gruñón, que ya de por sí no tenía sentido del humor, se hace con la poción de humor y rompe el hechizo.

programme.title: Medicina Para Bromista
programme.desc: Por culpa de todas las bromas que gasta Pitufo Bromista, ningún Pitufo le cree cuando les avisa de que el gato Azrael está a punto de atacarlos. Como se siente culpable, se dirige al castillo de Gargamel y le gasta unas cuantas bromas muy explosivas al mago y a su gato para poder liberar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: This show offers a captivating look into the extraordinary life of one of the 20th century's most fascinating women, seen through an American lens. It features clips from the auction where her dresses were sold.

programme.title: Diana: In Search of Happiness
programme.desc: Experience an in-depth look at Princess Diana, the extraordinary woman of the 20th century. Featuring unique interviews and touching clips, this portrait captures her incredible journey to fame and her ability to overcome the emotional and physical challenges she encountered nearly every day.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: Reflecting on Diana's legacy, this show delves into what Princess Diana left behind after her sudden passing - the impression she left on her children, the royal family, and the people who loved her. The young princes drew admiration with their demeanor at her funeral, but many questioned how their bond with Prince Charles would be moving forward.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E11 - Royal Children Prince William and Prince Harry
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, watch a thrilling collegiate pickleball battle between Purdue University and Creighton University. Later, Purdue’s Caleb Young and Tammy Lamb take on Creighton’s Noah Wodzinski and Elizabeth Cook.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: It's a high-stakes "Wednesday evening pickleball party" on Day 6 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) as Pune United takes on the Chennai Super Champs at the CCI Brabourne Stadium. With both teams currently sitting low on the points table (fifth and sixth), this game is a crucial must-win for both, offering a chance for one team to gain much-needed inspiration and move up the standings.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: Witness an unexpected and electrifying Mixed Pro Doubles showdown from the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships in Naples, Florida! Originally scheduled for a back court, this highly anticipated match featuring Andre Agassi and Anna Leigh Waters was moved to Championship Court due to overwhelming crowd demand, creating an unforgettable atmosphere. Relive every moment as these top players battle it out in a thrilling display of professional pickleball. Don't miss the action from East Naples Community Park – the epicenter of pickleball!

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Bengaluru Jawans go head-to-head with the Rajasthan Titans at the iconic Jio World Garden in Mumbai. The stakes are higher than ever in this Day 9, Tie 16 clash, featuring elite matchups such as the "women's singles player of the season" Katrina Stewart facing off against the resilient Lorena Dupnik. Watch as tactical masters like Dusty Boyer and Jack Foster battle for supremacy in a series of intense singles and mixed doubles competitions where every point counts toward the league standings. With game-changing "Pickle Plays" and atmospheric "drums" fueling the intensity, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit and strategic precision.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2022
programme.desc: YouTuber Danny Duncan teams up with Pickleball pro Anna Leigh Waters in a match against Pickleball pro Leigh Waters & teammate, former NFL quarterback Connor Shaw.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the tactical intensity of the World Pickleball League as the Rajasthan Titans look to mount a comeback against the surging Hyderabad Superstars. This episode spotlights a generational clash in the men's singles match between Rajasthan’s Jack Foster and Hyderabad’s Marcelo Jardim, a 51-year-old former world No. 3 in padel and a true legend of racquet sports.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden as the high-stakes battle for the top four intensifies between the Hyderabad Superstars and Delhi Dilwale. With legendary co-owner Sunil Gavaskar watching from the sidelines, the Dilwale look to maintain their winning streak against a fiercely aggressive Hyderabad squad known for their wild celebrations and relentless energy. This tie features a series of high-octane clashes, from the strategic precision of Shawn Mendes and Alejandra Lopez in women’s singles to the "grueling" 15-minute sprints of elite doubles play. As the "Band of Honor" leaderboard hangs in the balance, every rally becomes a desperate fight for survival in one of the world's most prestigious pickleball arenas.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The grand finale of the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional Championship, the second of six regionals for the season. The rivalry matchup features the top teams from Utah Valley University and Utah Tech.This broadcast highlights the intense Men's Doubles game, where Utah Tech's star player Liam Duffin—hailed as one of the top collegiate players nationwide—teams up with Clayton Boydston to face Utah Valley's duo of Bryce Larson and Charles Case.The stakes are high: teams are competing for $5,000 in scholarship money and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri, where $30,000 is on the line. Ultimately, Utah Tech's first team prevails, taking home the national bid and the Utah Regional title.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The National Pickleball League heats up as the Indianapolis Drivers take on the Austin Ignite in a coed team match packed with intensity, teamwork, and standout rallies. Representing two competitive NPL franchises, this mixed showdown brings high-level play, strategic depth, and crowd-fueled energy to the court. Whether you're cheering for the Drivers or backing the Ignite, this match is a showcase of what makes NPL team pickleball exciting to watch.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Stefan Andren and Alix Truong take on Christine Karges and Eric Oncins in this Mixed Pro Split Age Backdraw Semifinal match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: Filmed at the US Open Pickleball Championships in Naples, Florida, this Pro Women’s Doubles matchup features the powerhouse mother-daughter team Leigh and Anna Leigh Waters, known for their aggressive tactics and flawless communication. They square off against promising challengers Alexa Schull and Ava Cavataio, who bring fearless shot-making and tight teamwork to the court. From baseline drives to net duels, this clash of generations delivers fast-paced action, strategic rallies, and plenty of highlight-worthy moments.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.desc: In the finals of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, the Fort Myers Flamingos and the GMV Chomp go head-to-head. The commentators, including Angel, highlight the youth and fire of Fort Myers player Jade and the consistent dominance of the number one women's team, the GMV Chomp. The match is a best-of-three, rally-scoring format with games to 21. The episode showcases impressive plays from Stevie and Kelsey, and praises Heather Nobler's "nasty" two-handed backhand. The commentators also discuss the challenge for the team coming out of pool number two, which has less rest time before the finals.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: Witness a high-stakes semifinal showdown at the 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championships as the Texas Longhorns take on the Grand Canyon University Antelopes. Despite predictive analytics giving them a 0% win probability, the GCU "Antelopes" display elite "Skills" early on, jumping to a dominant 11-1 lead against the professional-level talent of the Longhorns. The "Racing" tempo of the match is fueled by a relentless GCU crowd that puts immense pressure on Texas stars like Zoya Khan and Natalie Loo. With the defending champions already sidelined, both teams showcase "Freestyle" grit and creativity in a battle to crown a brand-new national champion.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: This championship game highlights the strategic play, including lobs and speed-ups, as both teams battle for the gold. programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Experience the thrilling showdown at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships as twin brothers Hunter Johnson and Yates Johnson face off for the very first time in the men's pro singles gold medal match. Both top seeds with years of experience playing doubles together, these brothers bring a unique dynamic filled with expert strategy, rapid exchanges, and emotional rivalry. From early leads and tactical shot-making to late-game drama and camaraderie, watch Hunter and Yates battle it out point by point in a historic and captivating final. Featuring expert commentary and insights into their playing styles, this match is a must-watch for pickleball fans everywhere.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

programme.title: Around the ACL
programme.desc: ATA 223: Who's Under the Most Pressure? Breaking Down the Final Signature Before Worlds - With just one Signature event remaining before the ACL World Championships, this week on Around The ACL, Meesh, Jake, and Anthony take a step back to look at the biggest storylines heading into the home stretch of the season. Which players have the most to prove? Who's carrying the most pressure? And what does each contender still need to show before the biggest event of the year? - The crew discusses the players facing the highest expectations entering the final Signature, identifies the one thing they still need to see from several of the sport's biggest names before Worlds, and debates which contenders remain the biggest question marks despite strong seasons. To wrap up the show, it's another edition of "Change My Mind," featuring bold statements on Gabriel Clauson, Matt Guy, Logan Chamberlain, Ryan Wiedenfeld, the depth of today's professional field, and whether there are truly ten players capable of winning the World Championship. - Join us for an opinion-filled episode as we count down to the final Signature event of the season and begin the march toward Worlds.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.desc: Spring Walleye fishing on Horwood Lake friendly competition with local anglers using crank baits and jigging.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - Bluefin Fishing on the El Dorado
programme.desc: Over the last few years, we have been hosting sponsored fishing charters on the El Dorad, out of Long Beach Sport Fishing. Due to Covid 19, the sport boats have new guidelines to follow and only offer limited guests. This turns out to be a massive benefit to the passengers because they have more space for Fishing. On this adventure, we fish on the El Dorado for the first time since the pandemic began and have a blast.

programme.title: Catching Bass | All About Timing
programme.desc: Being in the Right Place at the Right Time for Huge Bass

programme.title: FishON! | "Trophy Walleye Adventure on Pierre Lake"
programme.desc: Join us as we kick off Season 7 with an unforgettable adventure north of Cochrane, Ontario, on the pristine waters of Pierre Lake. We team up with Mark Froud from Dunn Right Outfitters, an expert in Northern Ontario fishing, to target trophy walleye. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors
programme.desc: This week, we're on the road again, headed to the Mississippi to see our friend Adam Christianson to catch some perch! With the ice coming in slow this year it's time to hop on the airboat for a fun ride!

programme.title: Wired2Fish | Baits and Gear For the Biggest Catch
programme.desc: The team from Wired2Fish delivers the goods on how to catch the biggest fish—wherever or whenever you're casting lines.

programme.title: Angler's Workshop | Building Spinnerbaits
programme.desc: Jim shows you how easy it is to build 3 different fish catching spinnerbaits.

programme.title: Operation Fishing Freedom - Army Nurse Laura Ludwig
programme.desc: Through her 36 years in the Army as a nurse and medic, Laura Ludwig faced many challenges. None more difficult than taking care of the young men and women who served in Iraq and Afghanistan. Since coming home Laura has not stopped serving.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Angling Buzz - Finding Walleye
programme.desc: On today's episode of AnglingBuzz TV, we're talking all about finding walleye and how to catch them! Our special guest is Jason Freed who's a fishing guide on Minnesota's famous Leech Lake.

programme.title: Hank Parker Fishing
programme.desc: Fishing legend Hank Parker take viewers to the most secluded locations for the biggest fish.

programme.title: Catching Bass | Finding Pre-Spawn Bass

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat Fishing on the Ranger 85 (Part 3)
programme.desc: Join the Stoked on Fishing crew as they travel to incredible fishing destinations, chase down a wide variety of species, and share the stories of the people and places behind each catch. Whether it’s offshore, inshore, freshwater, or somewhere off the beaten path, every episode brings you along for the adventure — with real anglers, real conditions, and no scripted nonsense.

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors | Lake Michigan Lake Trout
programme.desc: This week on larry smith outdoors we hit the big lake michigan in search for some lake trout. We go far wiht this big booat! dont want to miss this one

programme.desc: In this exciting episode of FishON!, we hit the legendary Bay of Quinte with none other than Dicki (Richard Sommerville), the ice fishing legend himself. With years of experience and a knack for finding trophy walleye, Dicki helps us navigate the ever-changing ice conditions and put our gear to the test. From early morning setups to heart-pounding battles with giant Quinte gold, this episode is packed with action, expert tips, and stunning winter scenery. Don't miss the ultimate ice fishing adventure!

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: In this episode, Jerry and Austin are still in Nebraska hunting whitetails and muleys. After Jerry filled the first mule deer tag of the trip, the weather takes a turn for the worst and the deer movement slows down drastically. With just five days left in the trip to come up with a new game plan to figure out these whitetails and Austin's number one target mule deer, Jerry and Austin are worried that they may leave without filling another tag.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: It’s still opening week of bow season in Oklahoma and the crew has three tags left to fill.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy has been playing cat and mouse with a buck called “The Kansas 8” and after 2 encounters he is trying to seal the coffin on this big Missouri whitetail once and for all.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: David Blanton has had an amazing spring so far - almost too good to be true. You won't believe what happened on his latest turkey hunt in Georgia.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven working on some Big Tine clover maintenance and getting the plot he killed the Boss 8 in during rifle season ready to go. Tune in and get some tips for your clover plots and watch Randy take out the oldest deer on the Raven.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Every season, just like clockwork, mission-driven longboards gobble their way across the plains of South Dakota, the cornfields of Iowa, the timbered ridges of Michigan and the cattle ground of Kansas looking for their soulmates in one of the most celebrated hunting seasons in America…the wild turkey breeding season. Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Mark Kayser breaks down how to read elevation lines, hidden saddles, and thermal hubs to outsmart deer. Then, we head to the rugged breaks of Wyoming to see these strategies put to the test.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons and doves filling the skies, Mark is set for a fast-paced, action-packed finish to his hunt—a perfect end to an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This hunt tells a story in two parts. The first chapter follows Earl Peterson, Mark’s dad, as he steps into the field with one specific goal in mind. Experience, patience, and timing all play a role as the morning unfolds, setting the tone for the rest of the adventure. The second chapter shifts to Mark’s turn. On the coldest morning of the trip so far, the team heads into black-faced impala country. Wind, shifting conditions, and sharp eyes keep things interesting as they cover ground and look for the right opportunity. Every move matters, and nothing comes easy.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Each year we get to spend time in camp with some of our best friends. Zach from Big & J gets some time in a blind while reflecting on what hunting in Texas means to him. Texas provides a wide variety of game, and chasing these creatures all across the state is some of the best times had.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: From time to time you have moments that will change the way think about something. That is what happened for us while hunting the Scimitar Oryx with Republic Outdoors. Hunting is more than harvesting animals, it’s conservation, and in this story, we learn how a species nearly extinct gets another chance to live.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade takes Bentley on his very first duck hunt. Slade also gets to take a trip to duck hunting paradise with some great buddies of his. This episode is all about having a great time with great friends.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the old Trained Assassins crew are headed back to Montrose in pursuit of a big elk. The conditions are not favorable but the crew is sticking it out!

programme.title: LBP Spotlight
programme.desc: TA Mahoney is a classic mom and pop store known for going the extra mile and treating everyday people like family. Keep an eye on Mike though, you never know what kind of prank is up his sleeve.

programme.title: LBP Spotlight
programme.desc: Josh and his wife Anna own the most prolific tackle shop in Fort Walton Beach. Josh's family eats, sleeps and breathes fishing.

programme.title: LBP Spotlight
programme.desc: Meet just a few of the amazing crew members of the Old Salt Board of Directors. This nonprofit is more than just a fishing group. They make a difference in their community.

programme.title: LBP Spotlight
programme.desc: Kylee Short, an Orlando based bass angler, shares how she discovered fishing later in life. This LBP Spotlight highlights her journey on the water and strong family support.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. As this is Asa's first time turkey hunting some quick pre hunt preparations are in order. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and Caleb head back to Missouri to catch the end of bow season, - and the start of rifle. Slade arrows a great buck (twice), and we preview the latest property Slade & Co. purchased in MO.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade, Ryan and Bearcub take on the midwest! After some tough hunting, the group is able to make a move to get in position on a BIG midwestern gobbler! Bearcub was able to harvest him after working the bird for almost 45 minutes! Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his brother Tai take us around a new investment property - a 55 acre tract in Wilkinson County, MS and go over what it took to take an undesirable raw tract, to a place with multiple offers on the first day it was put on the market.

programme.title: Fly Shop Tour
programme.desc: This episode we make our way through Georgia, where we stop in Helen, Alpharetta and Atlanta!!

programme.title: Fly Shop Tour
programme.desc: This episode we make our way through South Carolina, where we stop in Clemson, Travelers Rest and Charleston!!

programme.title: Fly Shop Tour

programme.title: Fly Shop Tour

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This spring, our crew was able to dive into some turkey hunting at the G2 ranch with long time TTHA Members Mike Reeber and Dan Marcasol. After a slow start, the crew was finally able to connect on a great Rio Tom and a few hogs. Learning and sharing the stories of TTHA members is something we strive to do each year.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they chase Whitetails at Morrow Ranch. This is a hunt that they had purchased earlier at the Disabled Outdoorsman in the year to be able to spend some time in the woods. A few days away to relax and spend quality time with loved ones should always be a priority. Morrow Ranch is definitely a go to place for low fence Texas hunting.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Denise Sanchez was awarded a hunt at G2 following our Hunters Extravaganza drawings. Its great to get to spend time on the ranch with new members of TTHA. Denise gets familiar with a giant and learns about new technology while on this hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We love our members. We spent some time in camp with Ron Chandler. Ron Recently renewed his TTHA Membership in 2022 and was awarded a member hunt for 2023. We spend time reflecting on what hunting means to Ron and spending time in camp at G2 with hunters alike.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: WE join Bobby Falkenberg as he joins Bret Ferguson from Double T Outfitters. Bobby is an avid outdoorsman, judge, and father of 5. Bret manages 30,000 acres in Ozona TX, the knowledge he has of every inch of this amazing low fence ranch is remarkable. Bobby has an action packed 2 day hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Over the years we have been able to hunt with a lot of amazing people. This episode takes us to Las Palmas ranch to hunt with Payton Angelle. Payton was awarded this hunt from the amazing people over at Sky High for kids.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: The bond between and parent and child can grow in many ways, but nothing compares to the bond shared when hunting. The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters has becoming a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin and in 2021, Gavin was able to take his largest buck to date, with his dad Heath behind the camera.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff explore the breathtaking Waipio Valley, the Hawaiian "Valley of the Kings," in search of prawns and bullfrogs. Their adventure continues up a massive volcano, hunting invasive rams, before ending with a feast of native fish paired with island fruits and spices.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff hear about the dangers of fishing for Bluefin Tuna in the Atlantic Ocean from locals in Gloucester, Massachusetts. Then they head 30 miles out onto the open ocean with Darrin of Reel Respect Charters in the hopes of landing their own giant.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff team up with their friends from Boss Shotshells in South Dakota for a high-energy upland hunt, pursuing wild pheasants with the help of skilled hunting dogs. The adventure takes a quirky turn with a visit to the iconic Corn Palace.

programme.title: Spring Thunder
programme.desc: Low turkey population densities and the rocky, steep terrain of New York State's Adirondack Mountains create a unique spring turkey hunting challenge only found in this region of the country. programme.title: Spring Thunder

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 4 - Nature’s Heroes: Bangladesh - Part 1
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - USA: The end of oil - Part 1
programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll have to learn to do without oil within 20, 30 or 100 years. What will be the consequences? What are the solutions at stake? This new episode of Earth From Above attempts to answer these questions. From China to Benin, including Azerbaijan, Belgium and Canada, Earth From Above takes us on a new trip around the world, in search of black gold.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - A la carte grills

Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.
